pandas-dev/pandas.about: The standard Python library for working with tables of data. Almost every data scientist, analyst and data engineer uses it daily.

mlflow/mlflow.name: MLflow
mlflow/mlflow.about: Open source platform for building, tracking and evaluating ML models and AI agents, with an AI Gateway that routes requests to LLM providers.

BerriAI/litellm.name: LiteLLM
BerriAI/litellm.about: AI gateway that lets apps call 100+ LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock through one API, with cost tracking and load balancing.

unitycatalog/unitycatalog.name: Unity Catalog
unitycatalog/unitycatalog.about: Open source data and AI catalog for tables, files, functions and models. Its AI package turns catalog functions into tools for LLM agents.

databricks/dbt-databricks.name: dbt-databricks
databricks/dbt-databricks.about: The official dbt adapter for Databricks. It turns dbt models into Databricks SQL: tables, views, incremental merges, comments and constraints.

databricks/databricks-sql-python.name: Databricks SQL Connector
databricks/databricks-sql-python.about: The official Python connector for Databricks SQL warehouses and clusters. Used by apps, BI tools, SQLAlchemy and pandas to run queries.

pydantic/pydantic-settings.name: pydantic-settings
pydantic/pydantic-settings.about: Official Pydantic add-on for loading app settings from environment variables, .env files, secrets and the command line, used widely with FastAPI.
